Given the triangle $△ABC$ shown above, which of the following diagrams represents the altitude  corresponding to $\overset{―}{AB}?$
worked_solution:
The height (or altitude)  corresponding to $\overset{―}{AB}$ is a line segment that 

- runs from the opposite vertex $C$ to the line $\overset{⟷}{AB},$ and

- is perpendicular to $\overset{⟷}{AB}.$

The correct diagram is shown below:
